newsitem.title: UK: BFI rides higher on stronger Atlantic panamaxs.
newsitem.headline: BFI rides higher on stronger Atlantic panamaxs.

text.p: Stronger rates for panamaxes in the Atlantic continue to push the Baltic Freight Index higher, with a move up of seven points on Wednesday to 1,257.
Demand from grain charterers from the US Gulf is the main factor with a number of fixtures and enquiries to Egypt particularly featured.
Continental, Cargill and ADM still have outstanding 54,000 long tons heavy grain orders USG/Japan for end-June.
Atlantic caper rates are levelling off, several brokers believe, although conditions for these types in the Pacific are said to improved.
The market for handy sizes in the Atlantic has remained generally weak.
